question: what is the percentage change in the after-tax share-based compensation cost from 2009 to 2010?
reasoning: We need percentage change in after-tax share-based compensation cost from 2009 to 2010. Need after-tax share-based compensation cost. In Note 11, table: Share-based compensation cost 2010 $18.1, 2009 $14.6, 2008 $13.8 (in millions). Income tax benefit 2010 $(6.3), 2009 $(5.2), 2008 $(4.9). After-tax cost = cost - tax benefit (since tax benefit reduces cost). So 2010: 18.1 - 6.3 = 11.8. 2009: 14.6 - 5.2 = 9.4. Percentage change = (11.8 - 9.4)/9.4 = 2.4/9.4 = 0.255319... = 25.53%. Need exact figures as printed: $18.1, $14.6, $(6.3), $(5.2). Compute.
